provenance: Derived from the 14 opportunities curated by hand in backend/scripts/seed_demo.py. Every title, host, URL, date and quote was copied verbatim from the official page on the retrieval date; rules were structured only where the wording maps onto a fact the engine reads, otherwise kept as unparsed.
limitations: No page snapshots are stored: quote verification against page text cannot be evaluated from this version.
Facts are valid as of the retrieval date; deadlines and statuses on the live pages may have changed since.
Opportunity type, location mode, countries, languages and tags are curator classifications without quotes and are not scored.
Mandatory classification follows the curated default (all rules mandatory); no page stated an optional rule.
Requirements with review_flags rest on a curator interpretation and are excluded from rule-conversion scoring until a person resolves them.
Fourteen records from six kinds of provider cannot show statistically reliable accuracy; they show systematic errors.
